dataList.description: 로딩 직후 오프닝 연출(S1001B) 재생용 숨김 퀘스트

dataList.title: 퀘스트1 - 시작
dataList.description:
返回洗手间
 Return to the Restroom

dataList.title:
探索百货商场
 Explore the Department Store
dataList.description:
有些不对劲。我们回到了洗手间，但所有人都像是什么也不记得，默尔索也不见踪影。这一切不可能只是一场梦。去百货商场里看看吧。
 Something's off. We're back in the restroom, but everyone is acting like they don't remember a thing, and Meursault is nowhere to be seen. This couldn't all have been a dream. Let's look around the department store.

steps.goalDescription1:
探索百货商场
 Explore the Department Store

dataList.title:
前往快销服饰馆
 Head to the Casualwear Hall
dataList.description:
至少看来，那一切并不全是梦。现在先继续前进，专心寻找默尔索。他可能还在上次那家店里。
 At least it doesn't seem like it was all a dream. For now, let's keep moving and focus on finding Meursault. He may be back at the same store as last time.

steps.goalDescription1:
前往快销服饰馆
 Head to the Casualwear Hall

dataList.title:
寻找默尔索
 Find Meursault
dataList.description:
默尔索应该就在附近。找到他，和他谈谈。
 Meursault should be somewhere nearby. Find him and talk to him.

steps.goalDescription1:
与默尔索交谈
 Talk to Meursault

dataList.title:
把人台送到出口
 Show the Mannequins to the Exit
dataList.description:
想带默尔索一起走，就得先帮含羞草一个忙。尽快解决这些人台，然后离开这里吧。
 If we want to take Meursault with us, we'll have to do Mimosa a favor first. Let's make quick work of the Mannequins and get out of here.

steps.goalDescription1:
去寻找人台
 Go Find the Mannequins

dataList.title:
把人台送到出口（2）
 Show the Mannequins to the Exit (2)
dataList.description:
没必要再把这场谈话拖下去了。清理掉人台，继续前进吧。
 There's no need to drag this conversation out any longer. Let's clear out the Mannequins and move on.

steps.goalDescription1:
帮助人台“前往出口”
 Help the Mannequins "to the Exit"

返回含羞草处
 Return to Mimosa

dataList.title:
离开1层
 Leave 1F
dataList.description:
情况已经比上次顺利了。要想迎来不同的结果，我们就必须继续前进。当务之急是离开1层。先离开快销服饰馆，前往下一家店吧。
 Things are already going better than last time. If we're going to get a different outcome, we need to keep moving. First priority: get off 1F. We should leave the Casualwear Hall and head for the next store.

steps.goalDescription1:
离开快销服饰馆
 Leave the Casualwear Hall

dataList.title:
搭乘自动扶梯前往2层
 Take the Escalator to 2F
dataList.description:
我们遇到了上次也曾和我们交谈的杜布瓦。不过，现在没时间长谈。直接前往下一层吧。
 We ran into Dubois, who spoke to us last time as well. There's no time for a long conversation, though. Let's head straight to the next floor.

steps.goalDescription1:
搭乘自动扶梯前往2层
 Take the Escalator to 2F
